{{Top}}
A '''projectile launcher''' was a class of weapon that was capable of firing a variety of physical ammunition, such as canisters filled with a variety of chemicals, over long distances. The [[CSPL-12 projectile launcher/Legends|CSPL-12]], manufactured by [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]], was a type of projectile launcher.
